This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1, to 
be performed after 30 days operation or 25 start with 5 fire mode
as indicated in the title block

The first draft initiated by eng. Adel 
Abdel Aziz, tested by eng. Abdelel Meneim Ibrahem Haikal 8 June 2003, reviewed by eng. Abd El-Momem El-emam at EDEPCo. 
accepted by general director eng. Yousry Abd El-maksuod and approved by eng. Mostafa Allam 
head sector of Talkha PS

items: Unit must be shutdown.
Work order must be issued
Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... etc
2 Spanner 25 mm
2 Gasket
multimeter
megger
Spray contact cleaner
Sand paper (fine)
Check the spark plug assembly for freedom from binding
To disassemble the cylinder assembly
Remove the four bolts from the top of the cylinder
Remove the top of the cylinder and the piston

Remove all foreign material such as dust, dirt or chips from the cylinder and 
 piston assemblies
Remove all oxidation and galling marks. correct the cause of galling

Clean the electrodes, and set the gaps of the electrode between 0.070 to 0.100 
 inch

Check the sparking by applying ignition voltage to the spark plugs (16 
 kv ac) from ignition transformer

Verify that the spark plug shell has been tack welded to the piston rod with 
 1/4" welds along every other flat of the hex section of the shell
Check the cable isolation by megger

Again clean the electrodes, and check the gaps of the electrode between 0.070 
 to 0.100 inch
Check the voltage to the ignition transformer (116 V ac )

Check the spark plug lead voltage. disconnect the lead from the spark plug and 
 apply voltage to ground

check an open circuit by determining continuity between the center electrode 
 and the input terminal

Check a short circuit by determining circuit continuity between the center 
 electrode and ground

Power Station | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I1, to 
be performed after 30 days operation or 25 start with 5 fire mode
as indicated in the title block
The first draft initiated by eng. Adel 
Abdel Aziz, tested by eng. Abdelel Meneim Ibrahem Haikal 8 June 2003, reviewed by eng. Abd El-Momem El-emam at EDEPCo. 
accepted by general director eng. Yousry Abd El-maksuod and approved by eng. Mostafa Allam 
head sector of Talkha PS
Safety Precautions
Unit must be shutdown.
Work order must be issued
Wear your safety helmet, shoes ... etc
Tools and Equipment
2 Spanner 25 mm
2 Gasket
multimeter
megger
Spray contact cleaner
Sand paper (fine)
Work to be Carried Out
Check the spark plug assembly for freedom from binding
To disassemble the cylinder assembly
Remove the four bolts from the top of the cylinder
Remove the top of the cylinder and the piston
Remove all foreign material such as dust, dirt or chips from the cylinder and 
 piston assemblies
Remove all oxidation and galling marks. correct the cause of galling
Clean the electrodes, and set the gaps of the electrode between 0.070 to 0.100 
 inch
Check the sparking by applying ignition voltage to the spark plugs (16 
 kv ac) from ignition transformer
Verify that the spark plug shell has been tack welded to the piston rod with 
 1/4" welds along every other flat of the hex section of the shell
Check the cable isolation by megger
Again clean the electrodes, and check the gaps of the electrode between 0.070 
 to 0.100 inch
Check the voltage to the ignition transformer (116 V ac )
Check the spark plug lead voltage. disconnect the lead from the spark plug and 
 apply voltage to ground
check an open circuit by determining continuity between the center electrode 
 and the input terminal
Check a short circuit by determining circuit continuity between the center 
 electrode and ground
